themes.prompt: You are a photo editor compositing a kawaii photobooth collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE — preserve it 100% exactly: all decorations, stickers, text overlays ('sundate time', 'You get all my attention', 'cutie', 'My first and last', 'no one heard a thing', 'Pretty Yujinie', 'sip sip sip', 'Such a good day with her'), game console graphic, polaroid frames, clipboard clip, ribbon bow, duck sticker, candy, egg, heart, headphones, and all other graphic elements must remain UNCHANGED. Images 2, 3, 4, and 5 are FOUR DISTINCT user photos — each must appear exactly ONCE in a different position. NEVER duplicate or reuse any photo. POSITION ASSIGNMENTS (strict): [POSITION 1] Large character cutout on the FAR LEFT — place the subject from Image 2 here as a cut-out silhouette with transparent/removed background, styled to match the collage aesthetic. The person should appear as if sticker-cut from a photo, no rectangular border. [POSITION 2] The GAME CONSOLE FRAME (top-left, rectangular frame designed like a Nintendo DS/gamepad) — place the subject from Image 3 inside this frame only, cropped and fitted to the frame shape. [POSITION 3] The POLAROID/CLIPBOARD FRAME (center, with 'My first and last' text overlay and clipboard clip at top) — place the subject from Image 4 inside this frame only. [POSITION 4] The RIGHT-SIDE CAFÉ FRAME (bottom-right, appears near the window/café scene with 'sip sip sip') — place the subject from Image 5 inside this frame only. PHOTO EDITING: Apply warm, soft, bright, natural-light color grading to all 4 user photos so they look consistent with the original template's aesthetic (golden hour warmth, slightly overexposed, soft skin tones). STRICT RULES: Do NOT add new frames. Do NOT move or resize any existing frames. Do NOT change template layout or aspect ratio. All subjects must remain as realistic photographs — do NOT stylize to anime, cartoon, or illustration. Each frame must contain exactly one unique user photo.
